```bash
PI_WORKING_DIR=/home/sabeiro/.pi/agent pi
```

### Option 3: Simple cd then start
```bash
cd /home/sabeiro/.pi/agent && pi
```

cd /home/sabeiro/.pi && PI_CONFIG=agent pi
